thig15.1:1.1: samatto. || nagaramhi kusumanāme Pāṭaliputtamhi pathaviyā | maṇḍe Sakyakulakulīnāyo dve bhikkhuniyo guṇavatiyo. || ||
thig15.1:2.1: Isidāsī tattha ekā dutiyā Bodhī ti sīlasampannā ca | jhānajjhāyanaratāyo bahussutāyo dhutakilesāyo. || ||
thig15.1:3.1: tā piṇḍāya caritvā bhattatthaṃ kariya dhotapattāyo | rahitamhi sukhanisinnā imā girā abbhudīresuṃ. || ||
thig15.1:4.1: pāsādikāsi ayye Isidāsi vayo pi te aparihīno | kiṃ disvāna valikaṃ athāsi nekkhammam anuyuttā. || ||
thig15.1:5.1: evam anuyuñjamānā sā rahite dhammadesanākusalā | Isidāsī idaṃ vacanam abravi suṇa Bodhi yathāmhi pabbajitā. || ||
thig15.1:6.1: Ujjeniyā puravare mayhaṃ pitā sīlasaṃvuto seṭṭhi | tass' amhi ekā dhītā piyā manāpā dayitā ca || ||
thig15.1:7.1: atha me Sāketato varako āgacchi uttamakulīno | seṭṭhi bahutaratano tassa maṃ suṇhaṃ adāsi tāto. || ||
thig15.1:8.1: sassuyā sassurassa ca sāyaṃ pātaṃ paṇāmam upagamma | sirasā karomi pāde vandāmi yathāmhi anusiṭṭhā. || ||
thig15.1:9.1: yā mayhaṃ sāmikassa bhaginiyo bhātuno parijano || taṃ ekavārakaṃ pi disvā ubbiggā āsanaṃ demi. || ||
thig15.1:10.1: annena pānena ca khajjena ca yaṃ ca tattha sannihitaṃ | chādemi upanayāmi ca demi c ayaṃ yassa patirūpaṃ. || ||
thig15.1:11.1: kālena uṭṭhahitvā gharaṃ samupagamiṃ | ummāradhotahatthapādā pañjalikā sāmikam upemi. || ||
thig15.1:12.1: kocchaṃ pasādaṃ añjanañ ca ādāsakañ ca gaṇhitvā | parikammakārikā viya sayam eva patiṃ vibhūsemi. || ||
thig15.1:13.1: sayam eva odanaṃ sādhayāmi sayam eva bhājanaṃ dhoviṃ | mātā va ekaputtakaṃ tathā bhattāraṃ paricarāmi. || ||
thig15.1:14.1: evaṃ maṃ bhattikataṃ anuttaraṃ kārikaṃ taṃ nihatamānaṃ | uṭṭhāyikaṃ analasaṃ sīlavatiṃ dussate bhattā. || ||
thig15.1:15.1: so mātarañ ca pitarañ ca bhaṇati āpucch' āhaṃ gamissāmi | Isidāsiyā na saha vacchaṃ ekāgāre' haṃ sahavatthuṃ. || ||
thig15.1:16.1: mā evaṃ putta avaca Isidāsī paṇḍitā paribyattā | uṭṭhāyikā analasā kiṃ tuyhaṃ na rocate putta. || ||
thig15.1:17.1: na ca me hiṃsati kiñci na cāhaṃ Isidāsiyā saha vacchaṃ | dessā 'va me alaṃ me āpucch' āhaṃ gamissāmi. || ||
thig15.1:18.1: tassa vacanaṃ suṇitvā sassū sassuro ca me apucchiṃsu | kissa tayā aparaddhaṃ bhaṇa vissatthā yathābhūtaṃ. || ||
thig15.1:19.1: na pi 'haṃ aparajjhaṃ kiñci na pi hiṃs' eva na gaṇāmi | dubbacanaṃ kiṃ sakkā kātuye yaṃ maṃ videssate bhattā. || ||
thig15.1:20.1: te maṃ pitu gharaṃ paṭi nayiṃsu vimanā dukkhena | avibhūtā puttam anurakkhamānā jināmhase rūpiniṃ Lacchiṃ. || ||
thig15.1:21.1: atha maṃ adāsi tāto aḍḍhassa gharamhi dutiyakulikassa | tato upaḍḍhasuṅkena yena maṃ vindatha seṭṭhi. || ||
thig15.1:22.1: tassa pi gharamhi māsaṃ avasiṃ atha so pi maṃ paṭicchati | dāsī va upaṭṭhahantiṃ adūsikaṃ sīlasampannaṃ. || ||
thig15.1:23.1: bhikkhāya ca vicarantaṃ damakaṃ dantaṃ me pitā bhaṇati | so hi si me jāmātā nikkhipa pontiñ ca ghaṭikañ ca. || ||
thig15.1:24.1: so pi vasitvā pakkhaṃ atha tātaṃ bhaṇati dehi me | pontiṃ ghaṭikañ ca mallakañ ca puna pi bhikkhaṃ carissāmi. || ||
thig15.1:25.1: atha naṃ bhaṇati tāto ammā sabbo ca me ñātigaṇavaggo | kiṃ te na karati idha bhaṇa khippaṃ yan ti karihiti. || ||
thig15.1:26.1: evaṃ bhaṇito bhaṇati yadi me attā sakkoti alaṃ mayhaṃ | Isidāsiyā na vacchaṃ ekaghare 'haṃ sahavatthuṃ. || ||
thig15.1:27.1: visajjito gato so ahaṃ pi ekākinī vicintemi | āpucchitūna gacchaṃ marituye pabbajissaṃ vā. || ||
thig15.1:28.1: atha ayyā Jinadattā āgacchi gocarāya caramānā | tātakulaṃ vinayadharī bahussutā sīlasampannā. || ||
thig15.1:29.1: taṃ disvāna amhākaṃ uṭṭhāyāsanaṃ tassā paññāpayiṃ | nisinnāya ca pāde vanditvā bhojanam adāsiṃ. || ||
thig15.1:30.1: annena ca pānena ca khajjena ca yañ ca tattha sannihitaṃ | santappayitvā avacaṃ ayye icchāmi pabbajituṃ. || ||
thig15.1:31.1: atha maṃ bhaṇati tāto idh' eva puttaka carāhi taṃ dhammaṃ | annena ca pānena ca tappaya samaṇe dvijātī ca. || ||
thig15.1:32.1: athā 'haṃ bhaṇāmi tātaṃ rodantī añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā | pāpaṃ hi may pakataṃ kammaṃ taṃ nijjaressāmi. || ||
thig15.1:33.1: atha maṃ bhaṇati tāto pāpuṇa bodhiñ ca aggadhammañ ca. | nibbānañ ca labhassu yaṃ sacchikari dvipadaseṭṭho. || ||
thig15.1:34.1: mātāpitū abhivādayitvā sabbañ ca ñātigaṇavaggaṃ | sattāhaṃ pabbajitā tisso vijjā aphassayiṃ. || ||
thig15.1:35.1: jānāmi attano satta jātiyo yassā yaṃ phalaṃ vipāko | taṃ tava ācikkhissaṃ taṃ ekamanā nisāmehi. || ||
thig15.1:36.1: nagaramhi Erakakacche suvaṇṇakāro ahaṃ bahutadhano | yobbanamadena matto so paradāraṃ āsevi 'haṃ. || ||
thig15.1:37.1: so 'haṃ tato cavitvā nirayamhi apaccisaṃ ciraṃ | pakko tato ca uṭṭhahitvā makkaṭiyā kucchim okkamiṃ || ||
thig15.1:38.1: sattāhaṃ jātakammaṃ mahākapi yūthapo nillacchesi | tass' etaṃ kammaphalaṃ yathā pi gantvāna paradāraṃ.
thig15.1:39.1: so 'haṃ tato cavitvā kālaṃ karitvā Sindhavāraññe | kāṇāya ca khañjāya ca eḷakiyā kucchim okkamiṃ. || ||
thig15.1:40.1: dvādasavassāni ahaṃ nillacchito dārake parivahitvā | kiminā vaṭṭo akallo yathā pi gantvāna paradāraṃ. || ||
thig15.1:41.1: so 'haṃ tato cavitvā govāṇijakassa gāviyā jāto | vaccho lākhātambo nillacchito dvādase māse. || ||
thig15.1:42.1: te puna naṅgalam ahaṃ sakaṭaṃ ca dhārayāmi | andho vaṭṭo akallo yathā pi gantvāna paradāraṃ. || ||
thig15.1:43.1: so 'haṃ tato cavitvā vīthiyā dāsiyā ghare jāto | n' eva mahiḷā na puriso yathā pi gantvāna paradāraṃ. || ||
thig15.1:44.1: tiṃsativassamhi mato sākaṭikakulamhi dārikā jātā | kapaṇamhi appabhoge dhanikapurisapātabahulamhi. || ||
thig15.1:45.1: taṃ maṃ tato satthavāho ussannāya vipulāya vaḍḍhiyā | okaḍḍhati vilapantiṃ acchinditvā kulagharassa. || ||
thig15.1:46.1: atha soḷasame vasse disvāna maṃ pattayobbanaṃ | kaññaṃ oruddha tassa putto Giridāso nāma nāmena. || ||
thig15.1:47.1: tassa pi aññā bhariyā sīlavatī guṇavatī yasavatī ca | anurattā bhattāraṃ tassāhaṃ viddesanam akāsiṃ. || ||
thig15.1:48.1: tass' etaṃ kammaphalaṃ yaṃ maṃ apakaritūna gacchanti | dāsī va upaṭṭhahantiṃ tassa pi anto kato mayā ti. || ||
